recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Do not make canFilterBy.modifier mandatory or revert the later all-codes broadening under FHIR-39026; those changes would exceed the accepted issue scope and current source history.
issue_request: FHIR-39026 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification R5 FHIR-I change request asking whether `=` and `eq` in SubscriptionTopic.canFilterBy.modifier should be treated differently and whether defaulting to `=` should instead make the element mandatory. The accepted resolution says the distinction comes from FHIR search semantics and should be clarified by matching SubscriptionTopic canFilterBy definitions to SearchParameter's separate modifier and comparator definitions.
initial_application: Commit 07ab8970da2eb29b515d039788e861347d0cdfb8 applied the issue by adding SubscriptionTopic.canFilterBy.comparator, changing SubscriptionTopic.canFilterBy.modifier to SearchModifierCode semantics, removing the old subscription-search-modifier code system/value set, and updating examples and narrative notes. No earlier Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-39026 commit was present on the combined branch.
additional_context: FHIR-46492 later moved SubscriptionTopic.canFilterBy under SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy, with fhir.ini aliases from the old R5 path. FHIR-50614 later broadened the modifier binding to ValueSet/search-modifier-all-codes to include resource type codes for :type, but preserved the comparator/modifier separation. FHIR-I minutes confirm the FHIR-39026 9-0-0 vote, and direct Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active SubscriptionTopic StructureDefinition has SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.comparator bound to ValueSet/search-comparator and SubscriptionTopic.trigger.canFilterBy.modifier bound to ValueSet/search-modifier-all-codes, while notes and examples describe comparator and modifier values separately and point to SearchParameter/search behavior.

related_jiras.note: Moved SubscriptionTopic canFilterBy under trigger and fhir.ini now maps the old R5 canFilterBy paths to current trigger paths.
Broadened the modifier binding to include resource type codes for :type while preserving the FHIR-39026 comparator/modifier split; already represented on the combined branch.
